nli_rule: NLI positive iff entire current hypothesis supported by current premise; negative otherwise.
source: Original sixteen pilot NLI inputs, eight already-exposed R5 units.
visible_route: single format, positive/negative option keys, native premise/hypothesis question prefix.
contrast: Both arms append the identical existing consensus native-JSON instruction and identical NLI support rule. Full retains all original messages. Target-only retains original system, complete current question and original options/output suffix; removes preceding retrieval and the whole supplied demonstration block only.
pairing: Each endpoint is projected alone. Pair equality is audited only after construction; no gold or other endpoint enters request/optimize.
control_audit: Eight author-native positive/negative pairs checked offline to retain different original hypotheses; not generated in this 320-call batch.
candidate: optimize always uses target_only five seeds and existing exact-key aggregation; unsupported visible tasks return the original response.
analysis: Use separate nli_scope/analyze.py; original consensus analyze does not know these arm names.
scope: Mechanism development on eight exposed NLI units. Identical projected R5 endpoints are expected by construction and are not themselves evidence of correct predictions or clinical generalization.
